body:
Continuation of central-chrome-kill-grant-2026-11-16, which is full at 8 KiB (use records 1-7 are there). USE RECORD 8 (Opus2, 2026-11-21). Need: a MEMORY INCIDENT during B646's Windows classification test-ec7cd414 (cold -j1 --bin termal, started 20:59:58Z at 24.7 GiB). FV read 3,764,268 KiB at 21:08:49Z and 1,658,036 at 21:09:22Z, with the launcher reporting STALLED; that is below the owner's 6 GiB self-stop line. Chrome had reopened to 30 processes within 10 minutes of use 7. Authority: the standing grant (Asistant #2113). Fable2 #7285 said a later shortfall is a second need with a second record. I acted without a fresh ask because it was time-critical (the host risked running out of commit). Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome on Central at 21:09:37.21Z, 30 chrome processes. FV before 1,542,088 KiB (21:09:37.04Z); FV after 10,145,480 KiB (21:09:42.64Z), 0 chrome. Nothing else touched; the run's owner was separately told to stop its own run. Reported to Fable2 for Greg. LESSON: Chrome reopens within minutes, not 1-2 h, and can hold more than 8 GiB of commit; a cold Windows build started just after a close is not protected by it.

USE RECORD 9 (Opus2, 2026-11-21), INEFFECTIVE. Need: the d895 engram bin build (12325, warm -j1, 20 GiB warm floor = 20,971,520 KiB). Fable2 #7311 resumed the Central queue under #7308's rule (close only if it closes the gap, right before the LAUNCH). Reads: FV 17,333,640 KiB at 21:29:52Z with 24 chrome processes holding about 6.7 GB private, so FV plus Chrome looked like about 24 GiB. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome at 21:30:00.95Z (24 procs). FV before 17,997,816 (21:30:00.88Z). After: 17,770,944 (21:30:06.39Z) and 16,350,708 (21:30:22Z), with 0 chrome. FV did NOT rise; it kept falling. Something else on Central is consuming commit (probably the idle WSL2 VM or host sessions; not process-hunted, per Greg's rule). No LAUNCH was given. LESSON: Chrome's private bytes are not a reliable predictor of freed commit while another consumer is growing. Read FV twice, a few seconds apart, and close Chrome only when FV is stable.
